mentions.name: ripbox
mentions.description: A prototype CD player and ripper that rips CDs while you listen to them, backs them up, and makes the music available for streaming anywhere.
mentions.problem: The player is built around a family member's large CD collection and listening habits: playing full discs from start to finish at home and individual tracks when on the go.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on ripbox, a prototype cd player / ripper that than rip your CDs while you listen to them, back them up and then make them available for streaming anywhere.

My cousin has a large collection of CDs and the player is being built around his listening habits (listening to disk from start to finsh at home, individual tracks when on the go).
